A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

The field notes.

What is DataMapper Pro?+

DataMapper Pro is a Chrome extension for importing, mapping, transforming, and exporting structured data. It supports CSV, JSON, and XML, with a preview to help you check changes before export.

Who is it built for?+

People who regularly move data between systems: implementation consultants, administrators, operations teams, and anyone spending too much time reformatting files.

Can I buy or download it here?+

Not yet. This site introduces the product and its workflow. Download links and purchasing details will be added when they’re available.
